text_excerpt: Many older people on my street near King Rd will not leave their homes after dark now because there are no lights. This hurts their health and isolation. Please SUPPORT an emergency repair. This is urgent for our seniors.
I SUPPORT more housing but worry about doing it everywhere at once. Could the city phase it in near transit first and study the results? I lean yes but want it done thoughtfully.
Crime is up and you want to cut sworn officers? I OPPOSE any police budget cut. Fund more patrols now. Public safety is the city's first job.

Dear Councilmember, I live in Alviso and I am strongly OPPOSED to the proposed Terra Verde data center off Gold Street. Alviso already sits below sea level and floods — the last thing we need is acres of concrete and a facility drawing millions of gallons for cooling. Who gets the water when there's a drought, us or the servers? This belongs nowhere near a flood-prone residential community. Please

To the council office, Regarding complaints about Cedar Court: the central boiler failed and a replacement part is on backorder. We OPPOSE characterizations that we are ignoring tenants and request the city not issue penalties while the repair is in progress. We expect resolution within the week. Property Management

I SUPPORT the cap. I'm a renter and honestly scared my landlord retaliates for speaking up, so please keep comments private if you can. We need protection from huge increases AND from retaliation. Thank you.

I own a fourplex near Willow Glen. I'm not against a cap in principle, but it MUST allow pass-through for major repairs and property-tax jumps. With those, I could live with it. Without them I oppose. Please build in fairness for owners too.
If a landlord leaves tenants without hot water for a week there should be a daily fine that actually hurts. I SUPPORT steep habitability penalties. Cold water in October with kids is unacceptable.

I strongly SUPPORT legalizing fourplexes citywide. We have a housing shortage and single-family-only zoning is a big reason. More gentle density means teachers and nurses can live here. Please vote yes and ignore the fearmongering about 'character.'

Hi, I live near 5th and William downtown. Every rain over an inch the storm drain backs up and water reaches the driveways. Last January it got into my garage. Public Works or Water District? Starting here. Please look before winter. Photo below. [name removed]

Dear Councilmember, I am a hydrologist and an Alviso resident. I'm not reflexively anti-development, but the Terra Verde EIR appears to understate groundwater and cooling-water demand and does not adequately model cumulative flood impacts. I OPPOSE certification of the EIR as written and request an independent peer review before any vote. I'm happy to provide technical comments. Thank you. [name r

I'm a contractor and I'm at the permit counter weekly. It's not corruption, it's understaffing. I'm neutral on the fancy reform plan — just hire more plan checkers. That's the fix. Everything else is window dressing.

At Cedar Court it's hot water now but also mold in the units and a broken security gate. Main issue is the hot water but the whole place is neglected. I oppose letting this owner off easy. Please do a full inspection.
I SUPPORT funding late-night youth programs and job training in East San Jose as crime prevention. Give kids somewhere to be and something to do. Enforcement alone won't fix root causes.
Let's be honest — 'fourplex reform' is a developer windfall dressed up as affordability. None of these will be affordable. I OPPOSE it. Require actual affordable units or forget it.

I'm genuinely torn. We need the tax revenue and the land is industrial. But I also worry about water and traffic on Zanker. I guess I'd support it IF there were strong water-recycling requirements and a community benefit agreement. Without those I lean no. Just sharing honestly.
its freezing cold water only at our building off tully. been weeks. management says 'working on it'. nothing. i oppose how the city lets slumlords ignore this. please help us.

I saw crews put up a couple of temporary light towers near Story this week — thank you! I SUPPORT making the permanent fix a priority now so they don't come down and leave us dark again. Appreciate the quick interim help.

Before funding a big program I'd like to see actual data that the outage increased crime on the corridor. I might support it, but show the evidence. Right now I'm neutral and want facts, not anecdotes.

I want to protect tenants but the proposed cap number seems very low. Won't that discourage maintenance and new rentals? Maybe a middle figure tied to inflation. I'm genuinely undecided and hope you find a balanced number.
Permit fees went UP while wait times got longer. How? I OPPOSE any further fee increase until service improves. Show results, then we'll talk about fees.

The air near my place by 101 is visibly hazy and my kid's asthma is worse. I SUPPORT a sound/air wall and more trees along the corridor. Please prioritize freeway-adjacent neighborhoods for air quality help.
My Almaden street already overflows with cars. Four units where one house was, times every lot, with no required parking? Oppose. At least require off-street parking.
Every economist says hard rent caps reduce housing supply long term. I OPPOSE the amendment. Build more instead. Good intentions, bad policy.
My mother is 78 and on a fixed income in the same apartment for 30 years. Another big increase will force her out. I SUPPORT the lower cap for seniors especially. Please vote yes.

My ADU permit has been 'in review' for EIGHT months. Every cycle they ask for one new thing. I'm trying to build a legal unit for my mother and add housing — the thing the city says it wants. I OPPOSE this broken permitting process. Please fix the backlog.
Put cameras at the known dumping spots by the creek and fine people hard. I SUPPORT enforcement. Cleanups without consequences just invite the next dump.

Alviso flooded badly before and the levees are a constant worry. Paving over more land for a data center reduces where water can go. The staff report barely mentions this. I OPPOSE the project and I'm shocked flood risk isn't front and center. Please do better by Alviso.

Dear Mayor, As a commercial property owner in North San Jose I SUPPORT the Terra Verde investment. It uses an underutilized industrial parcel and brings substantial property tax. I'd ask the city to attach reasonable conditions on water recycling, but on balance this is good for San Jose's economy. Please approve it. Regards, [name removed] III
that alma avenue pothole is going to kill a cyclist. i swerve into traffic every time. fix it. opposed to how long youve left it. ive reported it like 4 times

This is the third time in two years the Story Road lights have gone dark for weeks. The city 'fixes' it and it fails again. I'm OPPOSED to the current contractor and the whole patch-and-pray approach. Either fix the underlying wiring properly or stop wasting money. Enough.

Everyone's focused on the big Alma Ave pothole, which yes, fix it — but the whole block is crumbling and a single patch won't solve it. I oppose a band-aid. Repave the segment. One patch and you'll be back in a month.
Following up — any update on the Alma Ave repair? Neighbors keep asking me. I support the fix; I just need a status. Thanks for any reply.

The pothole on Alma Ave destroyed my front tire this morning — $220. It's been there for MONTHS. How is this acceptable? I OPPOSE the city's maintenance priorities. I want reimbursement info and I want it filled this week.
The dumping near the creek is tied to the encampment there. I OPPOSE spending on repeat cleanups without addressing the encampment. Otherwise it's a bottomless pit. Deal with the root cause.

Read the fine print on that smart-light contract — ongoing cloud/software fees for YEARS. I OPPOSE locking the city into vendor fees to make a streetlight turn on. Buy reliable hardware outright and protect the wire. That's it.
I SUPPORT restoring the lights but I OPPOSE a new tax or fee for it. Reprioritize the budget you already have. This is a core service — fund it from existing money, not my wallet.

I signed a lease for a café in Willow Glen in January and STILL can't open because of permit and inspection delays. I'm paying rent on an empty space. I OPPOSE how the city treats small businesses. Streamline this or waive my fees for the delay.
I OPPOSE the rent cap. The real fix is building more housing — speed up permits and approvals. Price controls treat the symptom. Approve more homes and rents stabilize on their own.

everything is too expensive here and nobody in charge seems to care. rent food gas all of it. you keep building for rich people. i dont even know what im asking for anymore. just wanted someone to know people are struggling

Dear Councilmembers, On behalf of our member employers, the North San José Business Forum writes in conditional SUPPORT of the Terra Verde investment, which activates a long-vacant industrial parcel and expands the tax base. The attached letter, on our letterhead, recommends approval subject to recycled-water use, capped generator testing hours, and a local-hire construction commitment. We believe

I'm drowning in medical debt and read the county has a relief program but couldn't navigate it. Can the city help connect people to debt relief and financial counseling? I'd support a city navigator program. Feeling lost.
Attaching a photo with my shoe next to it for scale. This is on Alma Ave near the Washington neighborhood. It's a hazard. I oppose the delay — please schedule the repair and confirm a date.

Isn't rent control mostly a state issue? I'm confused about what the city can even do and whether a local cap survives legally. I don't know if I support it until someone explains what's actually allowed. Please clarify for residents.

There is a huge pile of mattresses and construction debris dumped along the Coyote Creek trail near Kelley Park. Been there weeks. I worry about it getting into the creek. I called 311, got a case number, still there. I SUPPORT the city's creek cleanup — I just need someone to show up this time. Thanks, Lupe

My neighbors and I are happy to do a volunteer cleanup if the city hauls what we gather. I SUPPORT a city-volunteer partnership for the Coyote Creek stretch. Give us gloves and a dumpster and we'll show up.

Councilmember, I OPPOSE allowing fourplexes on single-family lots citywide. I bought in a quiet part of the Rose Garden for the neighborhood character. Density belongs on transit corridors, not shoehorned onto every street with no parking plan. I support affordable housing done right — this isn't it. Vote no. [name removed]

Dear Councilmember, I OPPOSE rezoning the parcel near Blossom Hill Road for another strip mall. We have empty retail already and it'll add traffic to a bad intersection. Please deny the rezoning and consider housing or open space instead. [name removed]

i dont know who to write to. i got laid off from a warehouse near monterey rd in april and cant find anything steady. applied to like 60 places. im behind on rent and scared. is there any emergency help the city has?? anything. east san jose

Three catalytic converters stolen on my street this month. I don't know what the right policy is — more patrol? etching programs? I just want the city to do SOMETHING effective. Open to whatever actually works.
Is creek dumping a city thing, the water district, or the county? I keep getting transferred. I just want it cleaned near Kelley Park. Not sure what to support, just please someone take it.

I understand the crime worry but I OPPOSE blanketing neighborhoods with city surveillance cameras and license-plate readers. That's a privacy overreach. Fund patrols and lighting, not mass surveillance of residents.

The Alma Ave pothole is a symptom — our street budget is too small. I'd SUPPORT a modest dedicated road-repair measure if it's transparent and local. I'm tired of dodging the same crater. Let's fund maintenance properly.
I SUPPORT expanding non-sworn community service officers and better lighting/cameras rather than only adding armed police. Smarter response, not just more of the same. Please fund the alternatives.

Buenas noches, En los apartamentos Cedar Court llevamos más de una semana sin agua caliente. El dueño no responde y mis hijos se bañan con agua fría. Reporté al departamento de código pero no ha venido nadie. Me opongo a que ignoren a los inquilinos. Por favor manden un inspector pronto. Gracias. [name removed]

Estimados concejales, Apoyo bajar el límite de aumento de renta. Vivo cerca de Story Road con mis tres hijos y cada año la renta sube más de lo que podemos pagar. Tenemos miedo de perder nuestro hogar. Por favor voten que sí para proteger a las familias trabajadoras. Gracias. [name removed]

Estimados concejales, Vivo en Alviso y me OPONGO al centro de datos Terra Verde. Nos preocupa el agua: ¿cuánta van a usar esas máquinas mientras a nosotros nos piden ahorrar? También el ruido y los camiones. Alviso ya se inunda y nadie nos hace caso. Por favor voten que no, o al menos exijan un estudio ambiental completo. Gracias por escucharnos. Atentamente, [name removed]

Estimados, Llevo meses esperando el permiso para una pequeña remodelación. Cada vez piden otro documento. Es muy difícil y caro. Me opongo a estos retrasos. Por favor simplifiquen el proceso para la gente común. Gracias. [name removed]

Buenas noches, En mi vecindario cerca de Story Road ha habido varios robos a autos y casas. Llamamos a la policía y tardan mucho. Me opongo a que nos ignoren. Pedimos más vigilancia y que respondan a tiempo. Gracias por su atención. [name removed]

Estimados concejales, Apoyo permitir más unidades de vivienda en los vecindarios. Mis hijos adultos no pueden pagar renta aquí y tienen que irse de la ciudad. Necesitamos más opciones. Por favor voten a favor de la reforma. Gracias. [name removed]

Buenas noches, En la zona de Story Road las luces llevan semanas apagadas. Todo está muy oscuro y da miedo caminar de noche. Mi hija regresa del trabajo tarde y camina con el teléfono como linterna. Apoyo que la ciudad arregle esto pronto y que ponga cables que no se puedan robar. Por favor no nos olviden aquí en el este. Gracias. [name removed]

Buenas noches, Hay mucha basura y escombros tirados cerca del arroyo Coyote, junto al parque Kelley. Lleva semanas y huele mal. Apoyo que la ciudad lo limpie y ponga cámaras para multar a quienes tiran basura. Por favor háganlo pronto. Gracias. [name removed]

Buenos días, El bache enorme en Alma Avenue, cerca del área de Washington, sigue sin arreglarse. Mi esposo dañó la llanta del carro y es peligroso para las bicicletas. Lo he reportado varias veces. Me opongo a que lo dejen así tanto tiempo. Por favor arréglenlo ya. Gracias. [name removed]

Kính gửi Hội đồng, Tôi ủng hộ việc giảm mức trần tăng tiền thuê nhà hàng năm. Gia đình tôi thuê nhà gần Tully Road và mỗi năm tiền thuê lại tăng khiến chúng tôi rất khó khăn. Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu thuận để bảo vệ người thuê nhà. Cảm ơn quý vị. [name removed]

Kính gửi Hội đồng, Khu căn hộ của chúng tôi gần Tully Road đã mất nước nóng hơn một tuần. Chủ nhà không sửa. Trời lạnh mà con tôi phải tắm nước lạnh. Tôi đã gọi báo nhưng chưa ai đến. Tôi mong thành phố buộc chủ nhà sửa chữa và bảo vệ người thuê nhà. Cảm ơn quý vị. [name removed]

Kính gửi Hội đồng Thành phố, Tôi phản đối dự án trung tâm dữ liệu Terra Verde gần Alviso. Tôi lo ngại về lượng nước và điện khổng lồ mà cơ sở này sẽ tiêu thụ, cũng như tiếng ồn và xe tải suốt ngày đêm. Khu vực này hay bị ngập lụt. Kính mong quý vị bỏ phiếu chống, hoặc ít nhất yêu cầu đánh giá môi trường đầy đủ. Xin cảm ơn. Trân trọng, [name removed]

Kính gửi Hội đồng, Đèn đường ở khu Story Road và King Road đã tắt nhiều tuần nay. Buổi tối rất tối và nguy hiểm, hàng xóm tôi đã bị kẻ gian đập kính xe. Tôi ủng hộ thành phố cấp ngân sách sửa gấp và lắp dây chống trộm. Xin quý vị đừng để khu phía đông bị bỏ quên. Cảm ơn quý vị. Trân trọng, [name removed]

Kính gửi quý vị, Tôi PHẢN ĐỐI việc cắt giảm giờ của trung tâm người cao tuổi ở khu Alum Rock. Mẹ tôi đến đó mỗi ngày để ăn trưa và gặp bạn bè — nơi duy nhất bà giao tiếp. Nếu cắt giảm, nhiều người già sẽ cô đơn và thiếu bữa ăn. Xin giữ nguyên chương trình. Cảm ơn. [name removed]

Kính gửi Hội đồng, Tôi ủng hộ việc giảm mức trần tăng tiền thuê nhà hàng năm. Gia đình tôi thuê căn hộ ở khu Alum Rock và tiền thuê tăng liên tục khiến chúng tôi rất khó khăn. Nhiều gia đình người Việt ở đây cũng vậy. Xin quý vị bỏ phiếu thuận. Cảm ơn quý vị. Trân trọng, [name removed]
